candidates.change_summary: Change the required msg.value from exactly 10 ether to 5 ether, altering when fallback accepts and thus when pastBlockTime and possible transfer occur.
Remove the timestamp ordering check so fallback can update pastBlockTime and possibly transfer even when block.timestamp is not greater than previous value.
Change update of pastBlockTime to set it to block.number instead of block.timestamp, altering the stored value returned by the public getter.
Change transfer target from msg.sender to tx.origin, modifying who receives the contract balance when condition is met.
Insert a statement that doubles pastBlockTime after setting it, changing the stored value observed via the public getter.
Delete the assignment to pastBlockTime so the stored value does not update after fallback calls.
Move the pastBlockTime assignment to after the conditional transfer so transfers occur based on the old pastBlockTime rather than the updated one.
